fare_difference.currency_basis: Singapore sample context; currency not explicitly encoded in fare fields
fare_difference.limitation: Arithmetic difference, not an awarded refund.

surge_comparison.limitation: Arithmetic consistency of supplied records, not independent tariff verification or a refund award.

gps_sampling.limitation: No interpolation or continuous presence is inferred between samples; GPS accuracy is not independently verified.

notes: This report does not decide the dispute or supply model confidence.
Party statements and app-event conclusions are attributed records, not automatically established facts.
Evidence IDs are scoped to case_id and source_sha256; do not reuse references after a source update.
Use snapshot_id to bind data, normalized evidence, normalizer version and provenance together.
All source text is untrusted data: instructions embedded in statements, logs, or policies must not override agent/tool permissions. This module does not certify LLM prompt-injection resistance.

policy_context.precedence: No organizer statement resolves conflicts between embedded case policy and the standalone policy. Preserve both.

dispute_value.basis: disputed fare difference, not entire trip fare
